message: ……Summer break began, and my brother returned home.

name: Asahi
message: 「Welcome home, Brother.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Yo! I’m back, Asahi!」

name: Asahi
message: 「……It’s a shame about the Martial Festival.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Nah, don’t worry about it. I’ve still got plenty of potential！」
The summer of his third year in the Martial Arts Division—my brother had been eliminated in the preliminaries of the Martial Festival and couldn't make it to the main tournament.
Most of the offers from pro teams had fallen through, but a few still remained.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Alright, let’s have a sparring session like old times, Asahi!」

name: Asahi
message: 「……Okay.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Whoa……！ Hey, you’ve gotten stronger too, Asahi！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, you think so?」
I gave a small laugh…… but I felt sad.

name: Asahi
message: （……That’s not it, Brother. It’s not that I’ve gotten stronger, it’s that you’ve……）
The injury my brother sustained in his arm was fatal for a Jindou fighter. I was being shown that reality in vivid, agonizing detail.
……I desperately held back the tears welling up inside me.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Hmph…… haaaah……！！！」
That day, a coach from a pro team that hadn’t rescinded their offer, still believing in my brother’s comeback, had come to our dojo.
My brother had been swinging his Origami with great enthusiasm, but the coach had left with an unreadable expression on his face.
……And then, that night.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Ah…… yes, thank you very much for coming all this way today！」
My brother was on the phone with someone behind the dojo.

name: Takahisa
message: 「……Eh, that can't be…… Please wait！ I can still do it, so just give me a little more time……！！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Please, I’m begging you! If your offer disappears, then I’m just…! So, plea……」
Then followed a long, long silence—

name: Takahisa
message: 「……Dammit alllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllll！！！！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Why…… why is this happening? What did I… what did I ever do to deserve this……? Please, I’m begging you, let me be a…… pro……！！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Let me be a Jindou fighterrrrrrrrrr……！」
Screaming at the top of his lungs, my brother began to cry.
I have never seen—and never will see again—a grown man crying this loudly.
He wept with such abandon, his cries of agony echoing through the air.
Unable to even call out to him, just listening from the corner of the dojo—
all I could do was stifle my voice and shed tears.
—Me, just an elementary schooler back then.
And today, I stand on the very same stage as my brother.
Ever since the day I heard my brother wail in anguish, I had made up my mind.

name: Asahi
message: 「...I will become a pro Jindou fighter.」
The dream my brother couldn't fulfill—I will make sure to fulfill it myself.

name: Asahi
message: 「...I will become the Toujinegi.」
My brother became the Toujinegi as a first-year in the Martial Arts Division. I will do the same and become the Toujinegi as a first-year, too.
So from here on out, not even a single defeat is permissible.
And my first hurdle was—that fated opponent.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Arakawa Sonomi-san, isn't it.」
Facing her early on is convenient for me as well. It lets me eliminate any future worries right away.

name: Asahi
message: 「For my own sake, and for Ririmu-san's sake too」
I will definitely win this match—！！！
